repository-governance.description: Parallel repository mapping and architecture regression, followed by complementary final review.

large-change.description: Contract, parallel client/server, integration validation and complementary final review.

training-optimization.description: Read-only experiment, profile and kernel proposals with measurement review; trusted experiments remain separate.

refactoring.description: Behavior-preserving module refactoring through one six-stage-v1 large-change task; caller migration, rollback and independent final review remain explicit.

training-optimization-v2.description: Cross-domain experiment design, critical-path diagnosis, kernel/wrapper candidates and independent evidence review; readonly v2 proposals with original trusted experiment ownership.

optimization-memory-tuning.description: Capacity, allocation and hottest-rank memory diagnosis; three readonly v2 experts, no experiment execution or automatic graph runner.

optimization-activation-recompute.description: Version-matched selective and full-layer recomputation tradeoffs; three readonly v2 experts, no experiment execution or automatic graph runner.

optimization-cpu-offloading.description: Distinct layer, fine-grained activation and optimizer offload contracts; three readonly v2 experts, no experiment execution or automatic graph runner.

optimization-cuda-graphs.description: Readonly CUDA capture/replay scope, lifetime and paired caller-cost proposals; no automatic graph or GPU execution.

optimization-sequence-packing.description: Readonly native packing paths, sample/loss boundaries and valid-token proposals; real experiments stay with the trusted runner.

optimization-parallelism.description: Finite parallel meshes, topology constraints and independently verified training proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original runner owns actual experiments.

optimization-megatron-fsdp.description: Version-matched state sharding, checkpoint compatibility and recovery proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original runner owns actual experiments.

optimization-hierarchical-cp.description: Explicit hierarchical CP transport, active process groups and numerical evidence proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original runner owns actual experiments.

optimization-tp-dp-overlap.description: Effective TP/DP/PP overlap, critical-path contention and independent training evidence proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original runner owns actual experiments.

optimization-moe-dispatcher.description: Pinned MoE dispatcher selection, actual initialization and routing-correctness evidence proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original runner owns actual experiments.

optimization-moe-overlap.description: Plain EP overlap versus delayed wgrad, native constraints and independent measurement proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original runner owns actual experiments.

optimization-profiling.description: Trace identity, interval-union budgets, dependency evidence and bounded critical-path diagnosis proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original parser, collector and runner retain execution ownership.

optimization-memory-snapshot.description: Trusted allocator summaries, retained-history limits and aligned memory-snapshot difference proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original parser, collector and runner retain execution ownership.

optimization-recipe-model.description: Exact model and recipe selection, convergence invariants and bounded adaptation evidence proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original parser, collector and runner retain execution ownership.

optimization-model-verification.description: Per-claim model conversion, forward, training, resume and independent quality evidence review proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original parser, collector and runner retain execution ownership.

optimization-cluster-resiliency.description: Unique rank and job ownership, bounded diagnosis and independently verified distributed recovery proposals. Readonly v2 experts; original executor, framework and evaluator retain execution ownership.

optimization-low-precision.description: Bounded PTQ, QAT/QAD and TE training proposals with exact format/runtime coverage and independent quality/performance gates. Readonly v2 experts; original runner, native tools and evaluator retain execution ownership.

optimization-kernel.description: Kernel and wrapper proposals with fair baselines, independent correctness and measurement, and explicit native-workflow admission limits. Readonly v2 experts; original campaigns, runner, evaluator and adoption owners remain separate.
